P748.detail: P748 is a 10.49 km provincial gravel road in uMhlabuyalingana.

P748.authority: KwaZulu-Natal Provincial Gazette / Government Printing Works
P748.detail: Mbazwana operating routes leave the approved taxi rank into P748, cross R22 and continue into P447.

A1108.authority: KwaZulu-Natal Department of Public Works / eTenders
A1108.detail: Mbazwana Education Resource Centre is recorded on A1108 Road.
Ward 2 map labels A1108 separately in the Mbazwana/Sodwana-area network.

L2887.detail: L2887 and L3012 are internal gravel roads off R22 connecting settlements around Manzibomvu, Mntanenkosi and eNgwenyeni Schools.

L2887.authority: Expanded Public Works Programme / KwaZulu-Natal Transport
L2887.detail: Betterment and re-gravelling of L2887 recorded in uMhlabuyalingana.

L2887.reason: A1108 is separately documented in the Mbazwana/Sodwana-area network and is not evidence of the internal L2887 road serving Manzibomvu/Mntanenkosi/eNgwenyeni.
